score: IRC score = summed softmax over the IRC category's classes; accept a crop if IRC score >= threshold, else send to human review

ensemble.note: Accepted crops are 95% correct at IRC level but 82.7% at 14-class level on val; the rule targets IRC (PCU), not the class.

baseline.note: Fragile: the baseline's val IRC coverage curve hovers around 95% between 0-15% coverage, so t is wherever it last crosses the target and could move a lot with small data changes.

test_policy: Both arms' rules are reported on test with nothing chosen after the fact; prompts and thresholds are not changed after test is opened.
